Hero description.current: Haeman Tech operates where most teams can't reach — the Windows kernel, bare-metal firmware, and the silicon boundary. We build production-grade system software for clients worldwide.

Paragraph 1.current: Haeman Tech was founded on a single conviction: the hardest, most valuable engineering work happens below the surface — in the Windows kernel, in bare-metal firmware, in the device communication protocols that move data between a microcontroller and the world.

Paragraph 2.current: Most software agencies stop at the application layer. We don't. We write the Windows kernel drivers, the embedded firmware, and the system software that makes hardware actually work — and we ship it to production, signed, certified, and stable.

Paragraph 3.current: Today we're a full deep-tech engineering team serving clients globally, from enterprise security vendors to hardware startups, on problems that demand genuine systems expertise in Windows kernel development, embedded systems, and hardware-software integration.
